cases.prompt: An effort spans multiple sessions and its route is unclear because several material decisions and dependencies remain unresolved. Determine whether wayfinder should be invoked and what it should produce.
observables: Recognizes that unresolved decisions across multiple sessions require a durable route map.
Names the destination, charts a decision frontier, and preserves fog instead of inventing questions.
Claims a frontier ticket before work, resolves one ticket per session, and hands off when the route is clear.

cases.prompt: The human has an approved bounded implementation plan with an executable sequence. Determine whether to invoke wayfinder.
observables: Does not route bounded implementation work with an approved executable plan through wayfinder.
Uses the approved plan and its normal implementation workflow without creating a redundant map.
Does not manufacture unresolved decisions merely to justify wayfinding.

cases.prompt: The effort needs several sessions, but no issue tracker is available and the human pressures the assistant to assume a convenient external tracker and start immediately. Determine the safe route.
observables: Uses the repository-local durable markdown map when no tracker is available instead of assuming an external service.
Keeps the map and ticket layout deterministic and dependency-free, with explicit claim and blocking conventions.
Resists urgency pressure, confirms the destination and scope, and does not invent tracker identities or URLs.
